# Adeel Rahman — Actor, Karachi & Lahore, Pakistan

> Adeel Ahmed Rahman is an actor available for drama serials, film, television
> commercials, web series, theatre and voice-over in Karachi and Lahore. He
> works in Urdu and English and holds an MBA from Carleton University, Ottawa,
> Canada. His portfolio site also carries a live feed of the latest Pakistani
> dramas.

Site: https://crabbyai.github.io/mus/actor/
Contact: adeelahmedrahman@gmail.com · +1 613 408 3945 (WhatsApp)
Languages: Urdu, English

## What this site offers

- An actor's portfolio: who he is, what he brings to a set, and how to reach
  him for casting.
- A drama feed, refreshed hourly: the serials currently on air on ARY Digital,
  HUM TV, Har Pal Geo, Green Entertainment and Express TV, plus favourites such as
  Parizaad, Kabhi Main Kabhi Tum, Tere Bin, Ishq Murshid and Mere Humsafar,
  with every available episode.

## About the drama feed

- Adeel Rahman does not appear in the listed dramas; the feed is a watchlist.
- Episodes are embedded from each broadcaster's official YouTube channel.
  The site hosts no video and re-uploads nothing.
- Each drama also has its own page listing every episode:
  https://crabbyai.github.io/mus/actor/watch/<drama>.html (see sitemap.xml).
